rubric_notes: 直接可用 means acceptable for the fictional brief at ordinary viewing scale, not pixel identity, manufacturing approval, or print proof.
需修正 means the main task was achieved but a stated constraint or retained surface needs revision.
未完成要求 means the primary requested task was not achieved. None of the 18 outputs fell in this category.
Texture drift is visually judged, not a measured quality-loss percentage. Background recoloring naturally changes reflections; no such expected tint is treated alone as a defect.

The package input is a flat illustrative reference. Realistic rim highlights and material interpretation are not independently proven added components. Core silhouette/category checks passed, exact geometry fidelity was not established.
S3 needs revision under the requested clean upper-quarter whitespace, due to added foliage-like shadows. This is a brief-compliance judgment, not a universal aesthetic defect.

Text checked visually, not exact Unicode/OCR identity. Extra terminal full stops in edited headlines are recorded, not treated as lexical errors because edit prompts did not specify an exact punctuation string.
